# AeroLog Full AI Context Bundle

This file provides a consolidated, high-density reference for AI coding agents integrating or extending AeroLog.

## 1. Engine Core API (Rust)

```rust
pub struct AeroLogConfig {
    pub db_dir: PathBuf,
    pub max_segment_size: u64, // Default: 64 MB
    pub sparse_interval: usize, // Default: 100 entries per checkpoint
    pub default_retention: StreamRetentionPolicy,
}

pub struct AeroLogDb { /* encapsulated state */ }

impl AeroLogDb {
    pub fn open(config: AeroLogConfig) -> Result<Self>;
    pub fn put(&self, collection: &str, key: &str, value: &[u8]) -> Result<()>;
    pub fn get(&self, collection: &str, key: &str) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>>;
    pub fn delete(&self, collection: &str, key: &str) -> Result<()>;
    pub fn stream(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Stream>;
    pub fn scan_collection(&self, collection: &str) -> Result<Vec<(String, Vec<u8>)>>;
    pub fn scan_mutations_since(&self, since_hlc: Option<HlcTimestamp>, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<Record>>;
    pub fn compact(&self) -> Result<CompactionStats>;
}

pub struct Stream { /* encapsulated state */ }

impl Stream {
    pub fn append(&self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<u64>;
    pub fn read_recent(&self, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<StreamEntry>>;
    pub fn set_retention_policy(&self, policy: StreamRetentionPolicy);
}

pub enum StreamRetentionPolicy {
    KeepAll,
    MaxEntries(u64),
    TimeToLive(u64),
}

pub struct HlcTimestamp {
    pub physical_time: u64,
    pub logical_counter: u16,
    pub node_id_hash: u64,
}
```

## 2. UniFFI Foreign API (Kotlin & Swift)

```kotlin
class FfiAeroLogDb : AutoCloseable {
    companion object {
        fun open(path: String, maxSegmentSizeBytes: ULong): FfiAeroLogDb
    }
    fun put(collection: String, key: String, value: ByteArray)
    fun get(collection: String, key: String): ByteArray?
    fun delete(collection: String, key: String)
    fun stream(streamName: String): FfiStream
    fun scanCollection(collection: String): List<FfiKeyValuePair>
    fun scanMutationsSince(sincePhysicalTime: ULong?, sinceLogicalCounter: UShort?, sinceNodeHash: ULong?, limit: UInt): List<FfiMutationRecord>
    fun compact(): FfiCompactionStats
    fun shutdown()
    override fun close()
}

class FfiStream {
    fun append(payload: ByteArray): ULong
    fun readRecent(limit: UInt): List<FfiStreamEntry>
    fun setRetentionMaxEntries(maxEntries: ULong)
    fun setRetentionTtl(ttlSeconds: ULong)
}
```

## 3. Physical Binary Record Layout (32-Byte Header)

```
0x00..0x03 : crc32            (u32 Little-Endian)
0x04..0x0B : physical_time    (u64 Little-Endian)
0x0C..0x0D : logical_counter  (u16 Little-Endian)
0x0E..0x15 : node_id_hash     (u64 Little-Endian)
0x16       : record_type      (u8: 1=Insert, 2=Tombstone, 3=StreamAppend)
0x17..0x18 : key_len          (u16 Little-Endian)
0x19..0x1A : collection_len   (u16 Little-Endian)
0x1B..0x1E : val_len          (u32 Little-Endian)
0x1F       : reserved         (u8: 0x00)
Followed immediately by: collection bytes + key bytes + payload bytes.
```
